summary.zh-TW: 6 張卡片依序浮現。每張卡片上寫著自己的延遲時間，底部的時間條顯示播放進度，一眼就看得出 stagger 在做什麼。
summary.en: Six cards fade up one after another. Each card shows its own delay and the bar at the bottom shows playback progress, so you can see exactly what stagger does.

text.zh-TW: 從「指定的狀態」動畫回到元素原本的樣子。適合進場：寫出「從哪裡來」就好。
text.en: Animates from the state you specify back to the element’s natural state. Perfect for entrances: just describe where it comes from.

text.zh-TW: 每張卡片之間差 0.08 秒。改成 0.3 會像一張一張排隊；改成 0 就是全部同時出現。展開下方程式碼的 JS 分頁，就可以直接改改看。
text.en: Each card starts 0.08s after the previous one. Try 0.3 and they queue up one by one; 0 makes them all appear at once. Open the JS tab below to edit it live.

text.zh-TW: 起點：往下 48px、透明。位移太大會顯得拖沓，40～60px 比較俐落。
text.en: Start point: 48px lower and transparent. Too much travel feels sluggish — 40–60px stays crisp.

text.zh-TW: 一開始很快、最後慢慢停下，是本站統一的動態節奏。時間條用 none（等速），才看得出真實的時間長度。
text.en: Fast at first, then settles slowly — the house motion rhythm of this site. The progress bar uses none (linear) so you see the real duration.
